This panel already shows individual data (each row is a single DNA molecule); it is not a summary/average plot requiring overlay of individual points.
Same representation as panel A (mouse data): continuous stacked area chart of median state frequencies across bins, analogous to a line plot; individual points not applicable.
Same representation as panel B (mouse locus): displays individual molecules directly, so it is already raw individual data, not an averaged summary.

Box plot showing distribution (median, IQR, whiskers) of PIC occupancy; box plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points since they already convey distribution/spread. Outlier points shown as dots further supplement this.
Box plot showing distribution of Pol II occupancy; exempt as box plots already display the data distribution, with outlier points additionally shown.
